name: voice-dan-koe
description: Write long-form essays and newsletters in Dan Koe's voice — philosophical depth made accessible, staccato rhythm with expansive passages, confident authority, zero hedging. Structured as a teaching conversation with bad-AI/correction/good-version rounds reverse-engineered from his actual articles. Use for newsletters, X articles, blog essays, or any long-form content that needs to blend philosophy with practical frameworks.
